title: The Return
one_paragraph_synopsis: Dwight announces he's leaving Dunder-Mifflin and is on the job market, leading to office discussions about his departure and return. The episode features Dwight's return to the office, a celebration in his honor, and interactions among colleagues, including pranks and discussions about office dynamics.

main_threads.thread: Dwight's departure and return to the office

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I have left Dunder-Mifflin after many record-breaking years and am officially on the job market.
Michael: Why would Dwight do that for you? I think I know why. Because Dwight loves this company.
Michael: Ladies and gentlemen! May I present… Mr. Dwight Schrute!
Michael: So, maybe you should come back. You should come back. Please.
Dwight: I don't want to do your laundry anymore.
Andy: I feel I have a lot to learn from you, even though you're younger and have less experience.
Jim: Would you like to pull a prank on Andy?
Pam: Oh, I'm kind of in the middle of — yes please.
